mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(n.idx, b.idx) AS idx, COALESCE(n.title, b.title) AS title, COALESCE(n.smr, b.smr, '요약 정보 없음') AS smr, COALESCE(n.press, b.press, '출처 없음') AS press, CASE WHEN f.main_idx IS NOT NULL THEN 'main' WHEN f.breaking_idx IS NOT NULL THEN 'breaking' ELSE 'unknown' END AS type FROM ANS_FAV f LEFT JOIN ANS_MAIN_NEWS n ON f.main_idx = n.idx LEFT JOIN ANS_BREAKING_NEWS b ON f.breaking_idx = b.idx WHERE f.id = #{id} ORDER BY f.create_dt DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
